args.code:
# The algorithm:
# dl starts at 0x5c (92)
# For each index i:
#   - Get input[i] as c
#   - XOR c with dl to get result
#   - Compare result with target[i]
#   - Update dl = (dl + c) & 0xFF (mod 256)
#
# To reverse:
# result = c ^ dl
# So: c = result ^ dl
# Then update dl = (dl + c) & 0xFF

target = bytes([
    0x1a, 0xee, 0xaf, 0x68, 0x0d, 0x9b, 0x36, 0xb8,
    0x67, 0xa7, 0xb1, 0x0e, 0x02, 0xbd, 0x2b, 0xde,
    0x4e, 0xe5, 0xa6, 0x6a, 0xf7
])

print(f"Target length: {len(target)}")

dl = 0x5c  # Initial value
flag = []

for i in range(21):
    # c ^ dl = target[i]
    # So c = target[i] ^ dl
    c = target[i] ^ dl
    flag.append(chr(c))
    # Update dl = (dl + c) & 0xFF
    dl = (dl + c) & 0xFF

result = ''.join(flag)
print(f"Recovered flag: {result}")
print(f"Flag length: {len(result)}")

# Verify:
print("\nVerification:")
dl = 0x5c
for i, c in enumerate(result):
    computed = ord(c) ^ dl
    expected = target[i]
    print(f"i={i}: char='{c}' (0x{ord(c):02x}), dl=0x{dl:02x}, c^dl=0x{computed:02x}, expected=0x{expected:02x}, match={computed==expected}")
    dl = (dl + ord(c)) & 0xFF
